scope: New-plan Branch B pathway and rule selection; research and read-only source-data analysis only
question: Which MaleCNS pathway and experimentally supported local learning mechanism form the strongest complete candidate for first-action learning from fixed current-position input?
rationale: The pivot allows direct fixed KC input and makes the learning mechanism, internal plastic locus and downstream controllability the central selection criteria.
candidate_families: gamma4/gamma5 MBON with cognate PAM, if primary experimental support warrants
selection_criteria_in_order: Direct experimental support for plasticity in the named MBON/compartment and a local rule with stated sign and timing
Matching annotated MaleCNS cells and measured KC/DAN connectivity
Measured downstream route to an annotated descending neuron with transparent functional uncertainty
Compatibility with causal fixed position input, first-action feedback and fixed motor interface
Implementation and diagnosis burden within eight active development hours per complete candidate
intervention: Primary-literature review and deterministic anatomy queries; no neural simulation or weight change
frozen_controls: Existing MaleCNS release and source provenance
Historical synthetic and visual reports/configs/raw data/audits
Existing production electrical models and learning code
primary_endpoint: One coherent candidate package, or explicit INCONCLUSIVE if a package lacks defensible plasticity evidence or a measured output route
secondary_endpoints: Exact source IDs and edge counts for selected route
B2 design gaps and B3 falsification requirements

interpretation.PASS: A complete candidate can be selected with relevant experimental rule support and measured anatomy; success of learning remains untested
interpretation.INCONCLUSIVE: Available sources do not support a coherent package
interpretation.FAIL: No reviewed candidate meets the mandatory boundary/evidence requirements

prohibitions: No converting engineered numerical values to measured physiology
stop_condition: Finish B1 report and selection, propose B2 only; stop before candidate implementation
